about: The one version of the Common Agent Specification the whole lifecycle cites: every agent in agents/ and every standard in standards/ is written against it. The pin names the version, the tag it was published under in the Common Agent Standards repository, and the sha256 digest of common-agent/SPEC.md at that tag, so a reader can fetch the tag and check the bytes. A section number written without a version, such as Common Agent 12.4.1, is a section of this version. standards/test/common-agent-pin.test.mjs fails when a file cites any other version as a rule it follows, so a new version is adopted on purpose: read what changed, update the citations, re-pin, run the tests, release.
